name: agentive-workflow
description: Agentive review + implementation workflow for planning/code projects. Skills (bot-triage, code-review-evaluator, pre-implementation, review-handoff, self-review), workflow commands (check-ci, check-bots, wait-for-bots, babysit-pr, triage-threads, preflight, retro, wrap-up, start-task, status, commit-push-pr, check-spec), and agents (feature-developer-v7, feature-developer-v6, code-reviewer, ci-checker). Components are namespaced agentive-workflow:<name>.
